product_overview: NamastePOS is a micro-food POS and operations platform for business owners to manage authentication, menus, orders, invoices, QR-based guest ordering, staff, billing, and financial reporting. The system provides both owner-facing administration and customer-facing guest ordering flows backed by a PostgreSQL API.
core_goals: Enable secure owner authentication and session management
Provide fast menu and order management for POS operations
Automatically generate GST-compliant tax invoices when orders are collected
Offer owner-visible staff access controls and plan-limit compliance
Deliver financial and GST reporting with exportable statement and register formats
Allow subscription plan management and billing through Razorpay

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Lets business owners sign in with email/password or Google and retrieve their current business profile, plan, and feature entitlements.
user_flows: POST /v1/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with JWT token, refresh token, user, business, plan, and role -> GET /v1/auth/me with access token -> Receive 200 with current user, business, and plan features
POST /v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS
POST /v1/auth/google with valid Google ID token -> Receive authenticated owner session and business context -> GET /v1/auth/me with token -> Receive 200 with profile and tier features

features.name: Menu management
features.description: Allows the owner to view, create, and update active menu items grouped by category, including pricing, stock, GST, HSN, variants, and modifiers.
user_flows: GET /v1/businesses/:bid/menu with valid owner token -> Receive 200 with active menu items -> POST /v1/businesses/:bid/menu with item details -> Receive 201/200 with created menu item -> PUT /v1/businesses/:bid/menu/:id with updated fields -> Receive 200 with saved menu item
GET /v1/businesses/:bid/menu without valid token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /v1/businesses/:bid/menu with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Orders + POS
features.description: Enables staff or owner to create new POS orders, inspect live order lists, and update order status through the operational lifecycle.
user_flows: GET /v1/businesses/:bid/orders with valid owner token -> Receive 200 with current order list -> POST /v1/businesses/:bid/orders with selected items and quantities -> Receive 201 with created order -> PUT /v1/businesses/:bid/orders/:id/status to mark pending, ready, collected, or cancelled -> Receive 200 with updated status and, on collected, auto-issued invoice linkage
POST /v1/businesses/:bid/orders with invalid menu item references -> Receive 400 or 422 validation error
PUT /v1/businesses/:bid/orders/:id/status for a nonexistent order -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Reports - P&L statement
features.description: Provides Schedule III-style profit and loss reporting for a date range, with revenue, COGS, expenses, EBITDA, net profit, GST memorandum, and export formats.
user_flows: GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/income-statement?startDate=YYYY-MM-DD&endDate=YYYY-MM-DD with valid token -> Receive 200 JSON P&L payload -> GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/income-statement.pdf -> Receive downloadable PDF export -> GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/income-statement.xlsx -> Receive downloadable Excel workbook
GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/income-statement with malformed date query -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/income-statement.csv without authorization -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Reports - Income / Expense / Invoice registers
features.description: Provides transaction-level GST audit registers for income, expenses, and issued invoices, each with tabular data and export options.
user_flows: GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/income-register with valid token -> Receive 200 with all non-cancelled order entries -> GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/expense-register -> Receive 200 with expense detail and category summary -> GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/invoice-register -> Receive 200 with tax invoice register
GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/income-register.pdf without authorization -> Receive 401 unauthorized
GET /v1/businesses/:bid/reports/expense-register with no data for the selected period -> Receive 200 with empty register and zeroed summaries

features.name: Tax invoices (GST Rule 46)
features.description: Creates and manages customer-facing GST tax invoices with sequential numbering, line-item tax breakup, amount-in-words, PDF download, print preview, and owner-only cancellation.
user_flows: POST /v1/businesses/:bid/tax-invoices for a collected order -> Receive 200/201 with existing or newly issued invoice due to idempotency -> GET /v1/businesses/:bid/tax-invoices/:id -> Receive 200 with invoice details -> GET /v1/businesses/:bid/tax-invoices/:id/pdf -> Receive printable Rule 46 PDF
POST /v1/businesses/:bid/tax-invoices for an order that already has an invoice -> Receive existing invoice response without duplication
POST /v1/businesses/:bid/tax-invoices/:id/cancel with missing cancellation reason -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: QR codes
features.description: Generates a persistent JWT-backed QR code for each table so guests can open a public menu and place orders without a waiter.
user_flows: GET /v1/businesses/:bid/ops/tables/:tableId/qr with valid owner token -> Receive 200 with persistent JWT token -> GET /v1/guest/menu/:token without auth -> Receive 200 public guest menu -> POST /v1/guest/orders/:token with guest order payload -> Receive 201 with guest order confirmation
POST /v1/businesses/:bid/ops/tables/:tableId/qr/rotate with valid token -> Receive 200 with new QR token and invalidation of the old QR
GET /v1/guest/menu/:token with expired or invalid token -> Receive 401 or 404 access denied

features.name: Staff (PIN-based)
features.description: Lets the owner create and manage staff members with roles, PINs, phone numbers, permission overrides, and plan-cap enforcement.
user_flows: GET /v1/businesses/:bid/staff/pin with valid owner token -> Receive 200 staff list -> POST /v1/businesses/:bid/staff/pin with name, role, phone, PIN, and permissions -> Receive 201 created staff member -> PUT /v1/businesses/:bid/staff/pin/:userId to update profile or activation -> Receive 200 with updated staff record
POST /v1/businesses/:bid/staff/pin when active non-owner staff exceeds plan limit -> Receive 402 plan cap rejection
POST /v1/businesses/:bid/staff/pin/comply-limit with over-limit team -> Receive 200 and auto-deactivate newest excess staff

features.name: Billing
features.description: Displays available subscription plans, the current subscription, invoice history, and supports plan switching through Razorpay Checkout for paid tiers.
user_flows: GET /v1/plans with valid owner token -> Receive 200 with plans, feature keys, and limits -> GET /v1/businesses/:bid/billing -> Receive 200 with current subscription -> POST /v1/businesses/:bid/billing/change with target paid plan -> Receive checkout initiation and Razorpay payment handoff
POST /v1/businesses/:bid/billing/change with invalid plan identifier -> Receive 400 or 404 error
GET /v1/businesses/:bid/billing/invoices with valid token -> Receive 200 with SaaS subscription invoice history

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Email/password + Google sign-in for the business owner, with JWT + refresh token persisted to localStorage and an axios interceptor that auto-refreshes on 401.

response_schema.200: { token, refreshToken, user, business, plan, role }

features.name: Menu management
features.description: List, create, edit, delete menu items grouped by category. Each item has price, stock, gst_pct, hsn_code, variants, modifier groups.

features.name: Orders + POS
features.description: Take new orders via POS dialog, see live order list, change status (pending -> ready -> collected -> cancelled). Auto-issues a tax invoice when an order is collected.

endpoints.description: Change order status (auto-issues tax invoice on collect)

features.name: Reports - P&L statement
features.description: Schedule III-style profit & loss for a date range. Includes revenue from operations, COGS, operating expenses by category, EBITDA, net profit, plus a memorandum of GST collected. Exportable to PDF/XLSX/CSV.

features.name: Reports - Income / Expense / Invoice registers
features.description: Transaction-level detail registers for GST audit cross-check. Income register lists every non-cancelled order; expense register lists every expense with by-category summary; invoice register lists every tax invoice issued.

endpoints.description: Each register has PDF/XLSX/CSV export endpoints

features.name: Tax invoices (GST Rule 46)
features.description: Customer-facing GST tax invoices, auto-issued when an order is collected. FY-sequential invoice numbers, supplier + recipient details, line items with HSN, CGST/SGST/IGST split, amount-in-words, downloadable PDF + print preview.

endpoints.description: Manually issue (idempotent — returns existing if already issued for the order)

features.name: QR codes
features.description: One QR per table, JWT-signed token, customer scans -> opens guest menu URL -> orders without a waiter. PNG download for printing on table tents. Backend self-heals if migration 007 was skipped (auto-adds qr_token TEXT column, widens VARCHAR(255) to TEXT if needed, adopts orphan JWTs).

endpoints.description: Returns the persistent JWT for the table

features.name: Staff (PIN-based)
features.description: Owner adds staff with role (Manager / Captain / Waiter / Cashier / Kitchen), phone, 4-digit PIN, and per-staff permission overrides. Over-limit banner appears when active non-owner staff exceeds plan.limits.staff, with one-click "Comply now" to deactivate the newest hires.

endpoints.description: Create staff with PIN (rejected with 402 if over plan cap)
Update name / role / phone / PIN / permissions / isActive
Auto-deactivate excess non-owner staff (keeps earliest joined N)

features.name: Billing
features.description: Plan compare cards driven by the live /plans endpoint (enriched with featureKeys from plan_features matrix). Owner can switch plans via Razorpay Checkout. Subscription invoices listed separately from tax invoices.

endpoints.description: Switch plan (kicks off Razorpay Checkout for paid plans)

known_limitations.issue: Free-tier TestSprite has 150 credits — limit test plan to ~10-15 high-value cases.
known_limitations.impact: Cannot exhaustively test every feature in a single run.

known_limitations.issue: Some legacy types reference pre-Push-15 `tier` enum (free/basic/pro) alongside the new `tier_kind` (starter/pro/enterprise). UI maps between them but some test assertions may need both forms.
known_limitations.impact: Test cases that assert tier names should accept either vocabulary.

known_limitations.issue: Razorpay Checkout opens a third-party iframe — most plan-switch happy paths cannot complete without a real card swipe.
known_limitations.impact: Plan-switch tests should stop after the checkout iframe loads (don't try to drive Razorpay's UI).
